notes.title: EA v 0.12.0
notes.notes:
Hi everyone

The new version was released ːsteamhappyː

Added:[list]
[*] Fishing rod
[*] Fish in the lake (a lake located on the island)
[*] To fish you must create the fishing rod and you must have an apple to use as bait. When you fish successfully (yes, you can miss!) you’ll have a raw fish in your backpack. The fish must be cooked over a fireplace before you can eat it. The fish recovers 100% of your hunger
[*] Each use of the fishing rod decrease 2% of its life
[/list]

Changed:[list]
[*] The Sun position is now also synchronized in multiplayer
[*] Updated the save and load system to save the fishing rod
[*] Updated the save and load system to save raw and cooked fish
[/list]

Fixed:[list]
[*] The shelter now works and you can sleep normally
[*] It is possible to get water from the lake again
[*] Sometimes it was not possible to create a room to play in multiplayer, now everything is OK
[*] When entering a room and then leaving it was no longer possible to enter any other room, it is now working
[/list]

The surprise of this update is the addition of a new language, which opens the possibility for us to add other languages ​​in the future

The multiplayer mode is still in development and errors can happen, but just report the problem by [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/809470/discussions/0/2297346107921471312/]clicking here[/url] and we will start the fix so that everything is perfect for you ːghsmileː

notes.title: New update coming

To be able to catch fish you will need to create a fishing rod and you must fish in the lake located somewhere on the island

To fish you will also need an apple as bait

After catching the fish you should bake it over the fireplace before eating

This will all be better described in the game and when the game update is published

In addition to this update we are preparing a surprise and of course, we are fixing bugs

The update is expected to be released at the end of April, but if there is a delay/problem, we will release it in May.

Looking forward to the update? We are! ːsteamhappyː

Don't forget to review the game on Steam if you're enjoying it, reviews help a lot indie developers like us ːsteamthumbsupː

If you still don't like the game, wait a little, maybe you will change your mind ːfingerscrossedː

notes.title: New update coming
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

we hope you are well

2020 was not an easy year, we had many plans for the game but with everything that happened it was not possible to develop the game.
We had a lot of setbacks, but now that things are working out we came back with everything to continue and end the game.
The game will complete 3 years of early access on 2021-03-08!
This is far above what we had in mind when we launched it, but since the launch we have experienced several problems, such as incompatibility in the old engine, switching engines, changing the game art from 2D to 3D and much more!

We are an indie team of just 2 people and the amount of things to do in the game plus the limited time to work on the game (we don’t just work with games, we haven’t reached that goal yet) it became impossible to continue to develop the game and release updates regularly.

But finally we are managing to develop the game regularly and a new update will be available in February. The update will be released only in February as we want all the features that were already present in previous versions to continue to work.

The main changes will be in the 3D models we are going to use. We went back to lowpoly because it is the type of 3D that we are able to offer with such a small team.

This new version will have:[list]
[*] New Island
[*] New player
[*] Cooperative mode
[*] Build shelter
[*] Build fireplace
[*] Build torch
[*] Build chest to store items
[*] Build axe
[*] Build pickaxe
[/list]

The sword and snakes will be removed from the game as several bugs have already been reported by you. Achievements for sword and snakes will also be removed from the game. Perhaps we will add it again in the future.

notes.title: WE ARE BACK - EA v0.1.0 (again)
notes.notes:
Hello everyone
After a long long long time we are back!
We have so many issues that we need make the game from start two times. Now the game are in 3D, using Unity, all models done by us, we know that are not pretty models but are original.
In this first version we just make the base of game, you can:
[list]
[*]Cut trees
[*]Walk and run
[*]Craft a fireplace and a shelter
[*]Can eat if have an apple in the inventory
[*]Can drink water
[*]Rest on the shelter
[/list]

Removed:[list]
[*]All achievements are removed for now, we will put in future version again
[/list]

As said before, we just make the base of game, but we release because the last time we release an update to you was almost one year ago.

Known Issues:[list]
[*][strike]On Linux the camera stay stucked on the ground.[/strike] - Just keep your system updated!
[/list]

We hope you enjoy these changes, and if you have suggestions or find bugs, be sure to let us know.

[*]The player turns red if he takes damage
[*]The materials needed to build items now will only be highlighted if you still need to add, those that are already completed will no longer move
[*]Changed game font
[/list]

Bugs fixed:[list]
[*]Player no longer takes damage from a non build fire
[*]In some situations the days are not working
[*]When the campfire was destroyed the game continued to play the sound
[*]The boulder was not cracking after the last update
[/list]

Known Issues:[list]
[*]On Linux, sometimes the game does not get completely full, moving to another application and returning to the game is correct. We are trying to resolve this as quickly as possible. We have not identified the problem yet, but we've changed it so that when you open the game, switch to fullscreen.
[*]If you try to build more than one shelter, it will be disabled and you will not be able to add materials to the build.
[/list]

We hope you enjoy these changes, and if you have suggestions or find bugs, be sure to let us know.

Hello everyone,

Added:
[list]

[*]Sound effect when you die
[*]Sound effect of the fireplace
[*]Added a stone pickaxe
[*]Added a torch
[*]Added a stone sword
[*]Added a snake (snake intelligence is still very simple but we're improving it, For now the snake serves only to attack the player, in the next versions we will be adding other things to win by killing her)

[*]Added achievement of making an axe
[*]Added the achievement of making a shelter
[*]Added achievement of making a torch
[*]Added achievement of making a pickaxe
[*]Added the achievement of making a sword
[*]You can change the volume of the sound effects in the main menu
[*]To light the torch you should get close to a burning fireplace
[/list]

Changed:
[list]
[*]The trees that have fruit now appear a fruit in it
[*]Some trees are created when dawn
[*]Items now appear in order in inventory
[*]Now it is only possible to load a limited amount of each item

[*]In Linux sometimes the game does not get completely full, if moving to another application and returning to the game is correct. We are trying to solve this as soon as possible. We have not identified the problem yet, but we've changed so that when you open the game, switch to fullscreen.
[/list]

We hope you like these changes and if you have suggestions or find bugs do not forget to let us know
